name: 3D Console Bridge (NTM3D)
description: Hardware bridge for routing stereo output to legacy/3D-Vision/HDMI 3D consumer hardware. Ships with the MS213x EDID patcher (forces a 3D-capable display profile onto the connected display), the NTM3D EDID + firmware binaries, and the bundled 3DToElse_NTM3D.fx ReShade shader (the NTM variant of 3DtoElse). Distinct from 3DGameBridge — that's a software ReShade addon for SR displays; this is hardware-bridge + shader bundle.
license: See LICENSE in lib/3DConsoleBridge/ (NTM 3D, Creative Commons attribution)
notes: The 3DToElse_NTM3D.fx shader is the preferred 3DtoElse variant in Stereopticon — it carries NTM's extended output modes (HDMI Frame Packing, etc.) beyond BlueSkyDefender's original 3DtoElse.fx. The EDID/firmware pieces are only relevant if the user owns NTM3D hardware; the shader is independently useful.
